statements.statement: The patient has recurrent palpitations and dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring, CPT 93247, was ordered
The service was ordered to characterize the frequency and duration of symptomatic events and correlate cardiac rhythm with reported giddiness and palpitations
The service was denied under reason code CO-197
The denial was for missing prior authorization
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42
